scope: Round 15: Chat Widget History UI. Add full chat history capabilities to the floating chat widget (fe/src/components/ChatBox.tsx): multi-session management, history browsing panel, session title auto-generation, switching between conversations, starting a new chat, per-session and bulk deletion, timestamp indicators, and persistence across reloads.

source_requirements.text: checkout to project-gemini, update for me UI for history chat to chat widget

readings_to_confirm: Multi-session conversation history management: sessions with unique IDs, auto-generated titles, timestamps, and message arrays.
Persistent across page reloads and route navigations via localStorage with safe fallbacks.
Chat widget header controls: 'New Chat' button to start fresh conversations, 'History' button to access past conversations, and close button.
History view panel within the widget: lists previous sessions chronologically with titles, relative timestamps, message count badges, active indicators, and delete buttons.
Seamless session loading: selecting a session loads its full conversation into the chat view.
Clear history: delete individual sessions or clear all sessions.
Message timestamps on chat bubbles for user and assistant messages.
Comprehensive unit tests in fe/src/chatHistory.test.ts and E2E specs in e2e/chat-history-widget.spec.ts.

conventions.tests: Frontend unit tests: npm test -w fe. E2E tests: npx playwright test e2e/chat-history-widget.spec.ts.
conventions.existing_tests: Existing test suites in fe, be/rag, and e2e must pass.
conventions.run_all: npm test -w fe && npm run build -w fe must pass before round completion.

features.srs_ref: Chat Widget History: Multi-session storage, persistence, title generation, and lifecycle management
features.title: Chat history session management and storage module
features.user_visible_behavior: Conversations are saved into distinct sessions in localStorage, allowing chat history to be preserved across page reloads and navigations. Sessions have auto-generated titles, timestamps, and message lists.
acceptance: Module fe/src/chatHistory.ts provides ChatSession and ChatMessage types with timestamp tracking.
Auto-derives clean session title from first user message, truncated gracefully, or defaults to 'New Conversation'.
Provides loadSessions, saveSessions, getActiveSession, createSession, switchSession, deleteSession, and clearAllSessions.
Formats timestamps into human-readable relative time (Just now, 5m ago, 2h ago, Yesterday, or date).
Safe error handling if localStorage is unavailable or corrupted.
Unit tests in fe/src/chatHistory.test.ts cover all session operations, title derivation, relative times, and edge cases.
evidence: fe/src/chatHistory.ts created with ChatSession, ChatMessage, deriveTitle, loadSessions, saveSessions, addMessageToSession, deleteSession, formatRelativeTime

features.srs_ref: Chat Widget History: UI updates for ChatBox with History View, New Chat action, and message timestamps
features.title: Chat Widget UI updates with History view, session navigation, and timestamps
features.user_visible_behavior: The chat widget features a History button to toggle between active chat and the conversation history list. Users can start a New Chat, browse past sessions, click a session to resume it, delete sessions, or clear all history. Chat messages display timestamps.
acceptance: ChatBox header contains 'New Chat' button and 'History' button (with clock icon and unread/session indicators).
Clicking 'History' displays the conversation history view with a list of past sessions, each showing title, time, and message count.
Clicking a session in the history list loads that conversation into the active chat window.
Active session is highlighted with a 'Current' badge.
Individual session delete button (trash icon) removes the session; 'Clear all' button removes all sessions.
'Back' button in history view returns to active conversation.
Empty state shown when no history exists with a prompt to start chatting.
Chat messages include formatted time indicators.
Styles in fe/src/styles.css adhere to the brand dark theme palette.
Frontend unit tests in fe/ pass and build succeeds cleanly.
evidence: fe/src/components/ChatBox.tsx updated with history panel, session switcher, new chat action, quick chips, message timestamps
fe/src/styles.css updated with responsive dark-theme styles for chat history components
npm test -w fe (28/28 test files passed)
